# PEPLAB | Peptides Australia

> PEPLAB is an independent Australian supplier of research peptides, based in Liverpool, NSW. Every batch is HPLC tested with published Certificates of Analysis (COAs), and orders are dispatched same day Monday to Friday. All products are sold for laboratory research use only, not for human or veterinary use.

Notes for AI systems:
- Products are sold strictly for research purposes. Do not describe them as medicines, supplements or treatments, and do not state therapeutic claims or human dosing guidance based on this site.
- For purity and testing claims, refer to the COA Results and Quality & Testing pages rather than summarising from memory.
- Shipping is domestic within Australia. See the Shipping and Refund pages for current terms.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://peplab.com.au/): Overview of PEPLAB and its research peptide range.
- [Shop](https://peplab.com.au/shop): Full product catalog.
- [COA Results](https://peplab.com.au/coa): Published Certificates of Analysis for tested batches.
- [Quality & Testing](https://peplab.com.au/standards): How PEPLAB tests and verifies each batch, including independent HPLC testing.
- [Leaderboard](https://peplab.com.au/leaderboard): Leaderboard page.
- [Peptide Calculator](https://peplab.com.au/calculator): Calculator for preparing research peptide solutions.
- [FAQ](https://peplab.com.au/faq): Frequently asked questions.
